notes: Source: GCE's Mine Storm manual (the game built into the Vectrex), file Software/Mine_Storm_Manual in archive.org item vectrex_instruction_manual_collection; it names the «Built-in Control Panel», its «Joystick» and «the four action buttons», and says «Check to be sure the plug for the built-in control panel is firmly seated in the control panel outlet on the right». Quotes are verbatim lines of archive.org's OCR text (the item's _djvu.txt) of the maker's scanned manual, OCR errors and spacing included; the scan, not the OCR, is the authority, and a human should re-read each line against the page image. Mapping: joystick = lever 1 (stick-controller family); four action buttons (Buttons 1–4) = button 4; read as the panel's complete control list. wired=true: the panel plugs into the console by its cord. The Vectrex service manual is not used (dealer service documentation). Body dimensions, mass, cord length: no maker or museum figure found, null.
